seo.title: Altarious Global | PPC, Lead Generation, Inbound Calls & Live Transfers
seo.description: Altarious Global helps businesses acquire high-intent customers through performance-driven marketing, web leads, inbound calls and live transfers across insurance, home services and web lead verticals.

hero.headline: Acquire high-intent customers. At scale. On performance.
hero.subheadline: We run the campaigns, qualify the demand and deliver it to your team as web leads, inbound calls and live transfers, across insurance, home services and web lead verticals.

valueProps.title: Intent, not volume
valueProps.text: Every program is built to find consumers at the moment they are actively comparing, requesting or buying, so your team spends time on conversations that can close.

valueProps.title: Vertical-specific expertise
valueProps.text: Auto insurance shoppers, homeowners with a leaking roof and debt relief prospects behave differently. Our programs, qualification and content are built per sub-vertical.

valueProps.title: Real-time delivery
valueProps.text: Leads post instantly to your CRM. Calls ring your team the moment the consumer dials. Live transfers arrive warm, with the consumer already on the line.

valueProps.title: Measured and accountable
valueProps.text: Every call and lead is tracked to its source with full reporting, so you can see what is working and scale it with confidence.

howItWorks.title: Define the program
howItWorks.text: We align on vertical, geography, qualification criteria, schedule and volume targets.

howItWorks.title: Acquire demand
howItWorks.text: Performance campaigns across search, social, native and comparison placements reach consumers with active intent.

howItWorks.title: Qualify
howItWorks.text: Consumers are screened against your criteria, by form logic for web leads or by our team for live transfers.

howItWorks.title: Deliver in real time
howItWorks.text: Web leads post to your CRM; inbound calls and live transfers route to your agents while intent is highest.

howItWorks.title: Optimise
howItWorks.text: Source-level reporting feeds continuous optimisation of traffic, qualification and routing.

verticalsIntro: Three vertical groups, each with dedicated sub-vertical programs and product pages for Inbound Calls and Live Transfers.

cta.headline: Ready to scale customer acquisition?
cta.text: Tell us about your business, the verticals you serve and the volume you need. We will come back with a proposal.
